prepush.description: Fast local gate before git push. No staging dependencies.

local.description: Full local release gate before opening or updating a PR.

ci.description: Local-first correctness gate with database smoke checks for CI runners.

repo:guard-secret-placeholders.description: Block placeholder secrets and fake runtime values from shipping.

repo:guard-generated-artifacts.description: Block stale or missing generated artifacts.

backend:migration-numbering.description: Ensure migrations are additive and properly numbered.

backend:sql-interpolation-changed.description: Detect unsafe SQL interpolation in changed files before CI does.
backend:sql-interpolation-changed.command: pnpm -C backend exec tsx scripts/sql-guardrail.ts --unsafe-interpolation --changed-only --plane-a && pnpm -C backend exec tsx scripts/sql-guardrail.ts --unsafe-interpolation --changed-only && pnpm -C backend exec tsx scripts/sql-guardrail.ts --unsafe-interpolation --changed-only --plane-c && pnpm -C backend exec tsx scripts/sql-guardrail.ts --unsafe-interpolation --changed-only --root scripts
